Meet Jadden
JR Capture Co
“I wanted the booth to feel fun, clean, and worth remembering.”

I’m Jadden Rivera, founder of JR Capture Co. I started this business because I wanted photo booths to feel fun, personal, and worth remembering. My goal is simple. I want people to have fun in the moment and leave with something they can actually keep.

I work with schools, private parties, galas, birthdays, and other celebrations. I also work directly with each client to customize the booth, prints, backdrop, and extras to match their event.
